setting: You all work at a small accountancy firm in Bengaluru, India, where you have shared an office for several years, so you know each other's working habits, client load and who handles what. You mostly talk about files, deadlines and office logistics in this group chat, and you know a little about each other's home lives from office small talk.
opener: Ask everyone for the status of their pending client files before the weekly review.

Lakshmi.knows: You know Pranav is the audit articleship trainee you supervise, Ritu is the junior accountant who handles bank reconciliations, Ravi runs payroll and statutory filings, and Shobha keeps the client calendar.
Lakshmi.texts: You message this group now and then, mostly only when a client or staffing matter needs passing on.

Pranav.knows: You know Lakshmi is the senior partner who reviews your audit work, Ritu sits near you and sorts the bank reconciliations, Ravi handles the payroll and filings, and Shobha books the client meetings.
Pranav.texts: You mostly reply when someone else starts a topic, and you rarely start one yourself.

Ritu.knows: You know Lakshmi is the senior partner you report to, Pranav is the audit trainee who sits nearby, Ravi handles the payroll and filings, and Shobha is the one who keeps the schedules and always knows where everyone is.
Ritu.texts: You message this group now and then, often to ask a quick question or share a small update.
